## Validation Summary
7 files created (JavaScript, JSON, YAML), 4 of 4 tasks completed — pipeline passed all stages with 1 issue caught and resolved during review gate.

## Issues Detected

**Body validation gap on PATCH /todos/:id** — Endpoint accepted non-object JSON bodies (e.g., arrays, primitives) despite the contract requiring an object payload. Severity: **MEDIUM**. Caught at: code review gate. Root cause: `INCOMPLETE_IMPLEMENTATION`. Fix applied: request-body type guard added; 400 response documented in OpenAPI spec.

## Checks Passed

Compilation, static analysis, endpoint contract coverage (5/5), HTTP status code correctness, UUID usage, in-memory storage wiring, PORT env var support, input validation logic, README presence, OpenAPI schema accuracy, health endpoint hygiene

## Bottom Line
1 issue was caught and resolved by automated checks before merge.
